newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Next S.Lanka refinery turnaround due 1999 - CPC.
newsitem.headline: Next S.Lanka refinery turnaround due 1999 - CPC.

text.p: The next significant maintenance shutdown at Sri Lanka's sole oil refinery is not scheduled until 1999, the head of state oil company Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) said on Wednesday.

CPC Chairman Anil Obeyesekere told Reuters the last turnaround at the company's 50,000-60,000 barrels per day refinery at Sapugaskanda, just north of the capital Colombo, was between January and March of this year.
This would keep the unit working for another two years.
The next shutdown might be a little longer than this year's 45-day shutdown, he said.
"In 1999 it may be a little longer because we are hoping to refurbish certain parts of the refinery," Obeyesekere said in an interview.
